name: application-receipt-preview
title: Receipt Preview
description: Itemized receipt layout with subtotal, tax, and total, distinct from application-invoice-table since it renders a single standalone receipt document rather than a table of invoice rows.
useWhen: Showing a printable-style itemized receipt after a purchase or order.
Confirming a paid order with a payment-method footer in a modern card style.
Displaying order history detail as a standalone document rather than a table row.
avoidWhen: You need a sortable, filterable list of many invoices — use application-invoice-table instead.
The order hasn't been paid yet — this component assumes a completed transaction; use application-checkout-order-summary for a pre-payment summary instead.
No real line-item data exists yet — avoid rendering a receipt with placeholder amounts.
responsiveBehavior: Both variants have a fixed max width sized for a receipt-style document; line items wrap their label text if needed while keeping the amount right-aligned on the same row where space allows.
accessibility: Subtotal, tax, and total are each labeled with real text, not just visually distinguished by font weight.
The Paid status badge in Variant 2 pairs a color tint with a text label, not color alone.
The payment-method footer states the card brand and last four digits in real text, not just an icon.

variants.title: Thermal receipt
variants.description: Classic thermal-receipt layout with a monospace font and dashed section separators.
accessibility: Line items, subtotal, tax, and total are each on their own row with a real text label.

variants.title: Thermal receipt (Dark)
variants.description: Thermal receipt adapted for a dark page surface — the receipt paper stays white, as a real printed receipt would, with a ring for edge separation.
accessibility: The ring provides a visible edge against the dark page background where a shadow alone would not show.

variants.title: Digital receipt card
variants.description: Modern digital-receipt card with a Paid status badge and a payment-method footer.
accessibility: The Paid badge uses both a green tint and the word 'Paid', not color alone.

variants.title: Digital receipt card (Dark)
variants.description: Digital receipt card adapted for dark surfaces.
accessibility: Status badge and line-item text contrast must meet WCAG AA on dark backgrounds.
